title: Insecure Authentication - Missing Token Revocation Check
description: The vulnerable authentication middleware (vulnerableAuth.ts) does not validate whether the access token has been revoked. When a user logs out or their refresh token is rotated, the old access token remains valid until its natural expiration (15 minutes). The vulnerableAuthMiddleware only verifies the token signature and expiry, but does not check the RefreshTokenRepository for revocation status.
impact: Revoked sessions remain valid until access token expiry (up to 15 minutes). A user who logs out, has their account suspended, or undergoes password change can still use their old access token until it naturally expires. This extends the window of opportunity for session hijacking and unauthorized access.
mitigation: 1) Implement token revocation check in auth middleware by querying RefreshTokenRepository for token hash revocation status. 2) Store refresh token hash on login/refresh and check revokedAt field on each request. 3) Secure API (api-secure) implements revocation check in RefreshTokenCommand and LoginCommand via RefreshTokenRepository.

history.details: Initial audit finding recorded for missing token revocation check
